about.label: About Me
about.title: Passionate Visual Storyteller
about.text1: With over 8 years of experience in photography and video editing, I've dedicated my career to capturing authentic moments and transforming them into compelling visual narratives.
about.text2: From intimate weddings to commercial campaigns, I bring a unique perspective that blends technical expertise with artistic vision. My work has been featured in numerous publications and has helped brands connect with their audiences on a deeper level.

pricing.label: Pricing
pricing.title: What does it cost?
pricing.intro1: You naturally want to know what to expect in terms of price. Every video I make is custom. It depends on your wishes, the type of event, and how much content you need.
pricing.intro2: Below you'll find an indication of my packages. Think of it as a starting point. We can always look together at what fits best with your idea and budget.
pricing.ctaText: Curious about what I can do for your project?

events.title: Events
events.target: For events like CrossFit, Hyrox or other sport events
events.pitch: You get content that's immediately usable plus a strong aftermovie to capture the event.
events.item3: 1 recap per day (± 30 sec) — delivery: next day
events.tagline: Perfect to make your event immediately visible and keep impact afterward.

athlete.title: Athlete shoots at events
athlete.target: For athletes who want to capture their performance during an event
athlete.pitch: You get a personal video that truly showcases your moment.
athlete.tagline: Ideal for content you can share on socials or use for your personal brand.

social.title: Social content shoot
social.target: For gyms, Crossfit boxes or brands that want consistent social media presence
social.pitch: You shoot multiple videos in one day so you can plan ahead.
social.tagline: Great if you want to create a strong content batch in one go.
